title: Kirby Problem 1.63
exact_target: Can one fixed knot type have non-destabilizable Legendrian representatives with arbitrarily negative Thurston--Bennequin number?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2722 (KP-1.63). CC BY 4.0.
